## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector strength alongside major US equity ETFs above trend — SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND — while risk ratios are largely flat.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -9.77%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND. Credit mixed but slightly supportive as HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.37%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND; stocks vs bonds tilting equities — SPY (above) / TLT (below).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral overall: TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND shows duration pressure while HYG (above) signals limited spread tightening; dollar and curve indicators remain flat in the regime data.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Tech holding momentum: XLK (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +7.04%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary in CORRECTION: XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION. Utilities in RECOVERY: XLU (1W: +1.61% | 1M: -2.55%) RECOVERY. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US slightly stronger: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND. Emerging markets constructive: EEM (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +3.77%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Europe RECOVERY: VGK (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +4.03%) CORRECTION. China showing weakness and near-term risk: FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation healthy but selective: ARKK (1W: +2.10% | 1M: +5.78%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +3.21%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND; crypto risk elevated — IBIT (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -2.09%) ↓ falling | BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) → flat | ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals supportive: CPER (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +5.12%) → flat | ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing leadership and momentum: XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.91% | 1M: +8.25%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND. Natural gas fragile: UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY — watch for reversion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: major US equity trend (SPY, QQQ, IWM) ABOVE TREND and sector breadth 8/11 supports upside. Divergences are present but minor (FXI, KWEB, XLY in CORRECTION/BELOW TREND) — no major multi-core ETF divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and energy exposures showing momentum — XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +18.34%) ABOVE TREND — reduce exposure to China/China-tech ETFs showing correction risk — FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION and KWEB (1W: -5.76% | 1M: -1.71%) BELOW TREND; monitor duration pressure via TLT (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -2.18%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +7.67% | 1M: +8.58%) ABOVE TREND given strong flows and BNO strength. BULLISH: Materials/Miners — XME (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +18.34%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary — XLY (1W: -1.38% | 1M: +0.73%) CORRECTION. BEARISH: China equities — FXI (1W: -3.54% | 1M: +1.04%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Silver SLV (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +16.05%) ↑ rising | ABOVE TREND and Gold GLD (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +10.01%) ABOVE TREND for safe-haven flows. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: +1.85% | 1M: -4.80%) RECOVERY — staying fragile on monthly basis.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold). HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health gauge). XLK/XLF ~2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, US large-cap ETFs SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +3.41%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +3.56%) ABOVE TREND are supporting the market. Strength in Energy and Materials (XLE, XME) versus correction signals in China and Discretionary (FXI, XLY) is the key divergence to monitor.
